page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening), running text in one column with a diagram of braces in the middle and a catchword-like line at the foot; a fragment of the facing left page at the left edge is not transcribed. Page number at head; running head "Lib. 4." left and "De sacerdotio Christi." right.

l.i: Atq; haec de actionibus sacerdotalibus in humi-

main_text.l: Actiones in Gloria, sunt actiones sacerdota-
les sacerdotium perficientes, regni vero initia &
Resurrectio est prima actio, qua morte eiusq;
dominio subactis, diuina potentia suscitatus, in
Huius finis duplex est. Secundus ad regnum, ut diabolo
sequentes sunt Ascensio. Sessio ad dextram Dei.

page.notes: Diagram braces: "Resurrectio / Resurrectionem / sequentes" and "Primus / Secundus" and "Ascensio / Sessio" are reproduced in running text; the opening and closing brace shapes are not reproduced. The left edge shows a fragment of the facing page, not transcribed. Greek in the line "Huius finis" is transcribed approximately: "ἀδ᾽ ᾳ κέντρον" is doubtful [?].
